result.brief: 提出 Wave Forcing：通过分块因果注意力、交错去噪与三阶段训练实现连续流式长视频生成，并配套 Wave Parallelism 运行时加速。
result.reason: Co-designs chunk-wise causal autoregressive streaming video generation with staggered multi-step denoising, training schedule, and parallel runtime; directly advances long/real-time video generation.
